hook.line: Client results: views going from 632 to 21M.
hook.visual: Selfie close-up; two view-count tiles (632 and 21M) at top with a red arrow between them; she points up at them. 'Client Results' title.

beats.what: 632 to 21M view tiles with an animated red arrow; she points at them
Step text: Go to ChatGPT, add your topic + context
ChatGPT prompt bar: generate SEO keywords, comma-separated, one line
Cut to ChatGPT reply with the keyword list over her
Inset clip of a video where the keywords are used
Closing title: Low Effort, High Returns

why_it_works: Result first: a 632 to 21M jump with an arrow is shown before the method, so the viewer stays to learn how.
One copyable prompt is shown on screen, which makes it worth saving (2,830 shares).
'Part 4' signals a series and gives a reason to look for the other parts.
23 s and a cut about every 2.6 s (median) leave no slack.
weaknesses: The 21M claim is never explained or tied to the keyword trick.
for_robert: Open on a before/after number pair with an arrow, and have Fred point at it the way she does. Then tie the number to the method so it doesn't read as bait.
